category_title: Adolescent students with learning disabilities who under-request accommodations and struggle with the social steps of self-advocacy
minimal_context: The student is completing a Skills Inventory Survey in a special education English class to identify their strengths and needs.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please complete this Skills Inventory Survey so we can identify your strengths and needs, and figure out what accommodations you might need.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't think I will ever need an accommodation. I've never requested one.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's just go through the list of skills on the survey.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't even know what an LD is or that I have this learning condition.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think should happen with your accommodations?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I expect my teachers to be responsible for my accommodations. I have little to do with them.
